His parents were first cousins: his grandmothers were sisters from Smyrna (modern day İzmir, Turkey).[3] His paternal grandmother, Catherine Chilé, was raised in Marseille, where she married Marius Artaud, a Frenchman. His maternal grandmother, Mariette Chilé, grew up in Smyrna, where she married Louis Nalpas, a local ship chandler.[11] Euphrasie gave birth to nine children, but four were stillborn and two others died in childhood.[3].
